description: **Feature.** Scaffold now tracks generated files in `.rlsbl/managed-files.json` and automatically deletes orphans on re-scaffold. Hash comparison protects user-modified files. Separate from `hashes.json` (change detection).
**Feature.** Scaffold only generates lint configs for declared targets (pypi→python.toml, npm→npm.toml, go→go.toml). Unused configs are orphan-detected on next scaffold.
